recommendation: Keep the source fix. No separate core commit is needed for FHIR-54332 from this worker because it was closed as the duplicate of the same Dosage.site change.
issue_request: FHIR-54848 was an Applied/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for R6 to change Dosage.site from CodeableConcept to CodeableReference(BodyStructure) while keeping the same binding on the CodeableConcept part.
initial_application: Commit b33db10cfc changed source/datatypes/dosage.xml so Dosage.site has type CodeableReference(BodyStructure) and added a FHIR-54848 changelog entry. The structural change was present in the current source, but the requirements/comment cells still described a coded-only site and directed implementers to the bodySite extension for BodyStructure-style detail.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Dosage as an active datatype and maps it to the dosage page, so source/datatypes/dosage.xml is current build-scope source. Pharmacy's 2026-03-02 minutes record the FHIR-54332 + FHIR-54848 discussion, the 8-0-0 vote to change Dosage.site to CodeableReference(BodyStructure), and FHIR-54332 closure as a duplicate. Focused Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Updated only the Dosage.site requirements and comment cells in source/datatypes/dosage.xml. The row now describes a coded or referenced site and says the element may carry a summary code, a BodyStructure reference with laterality/location qualifiers, or both; the existing MedicationAdministrationSite binding remains unchanged.
source_changes: source/datatypes/dosage.xml: changed Dosage.site requirements from coded-only wording to coded-or-referenced wording.
source/datatypes/dosage.xml: replaced stale BodySite extension guidance with CodeableReference/BodyStructure guidance that mentions laterality and location qualifiers.
